notes:
A free Windows desktop companion for your own Codex usage.

New in 1.1.1: Settings now contains a collapsed Danger zone with Uninstall app. A native confirmation opens the installed application's Windows uninstaller. Portable copies explain file removal and open Windows installed apps instead.

Download CodexBuddy-Setup.exe to install, or CodexBuddy.exe for the portable version. Follow the first-run guide and connect your own ChatGPT account with Codex access.

Includes five-hour and weekly allowance, reset countdowns, tray icon, Ctrl+Alt+C show/hide, corner snapping, optional always-on-top, position lock, and optional usage colors.

Installation walkthrough: https://codexbuddy.vercel.app/installation

This release is unsigned. Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning. SHA-256 checksums are provided in SHA256SUMS.txt.

Independent companion, not affiliated with OpenAI.
